root_cause: The screen was blanked on a STALE 5.9 s photo while the player was moving, and yt_source_paused stayed armed, so unpausing never repainted.

attempts.action: Single owner youtube_clock.pause_proven(clock_static, clock_moving, photo_fresh) with measured movement winning, DOM_FRESH_S=1.2 from the snapshot's own stamp, YOUTUBE_PAUSE_STALE_PHOTO named per episode, and no path arming yt_source_paused without pause_proven.
attempts.rationale: One rule, one owner: two witnesses that disagree cannot both be right, and a photo older than the freshness threshold is not a witness at all.
attempts.predicted_outcome: Contradicted pause episodes 0 on the owner's log; a real pause still blanks (arm19/arm20 stay green).
attempts.observed_outcome: episodes=2 contradicted=0 CLEAN rc 0 on his log (18 contradicted before the fix, 1 in his session); arm19-static-pause-still-blanks and arm20-cached-snapshot-is-not-a-second-measure green.

root_cause: One accessibility-tree read of 16437 ms had no per-stage budget, so it blocked the 4 Hz loop and collapsed it to 0.5 Hz.

attempts.action: app/webview/yt_read_budget.py: UIA_BUDGET_MS=350, HOLD_SCALE=3.0, HOLD_MIN_S=2.0; a read over budget buys a named hold and serves the last words instead of blocking again.
attempts.rationale: A stage has a budget and a typed refusal, never a clock that hides where it stalled.
attempts.predicted_outcome: Simulated cadence with his numbers rises from 0.067 Hz to about 2.95 Hz; the episode prints YOUTUBE_UIA_SLOW_BUDGET instead of freezing silently.
attempts.observed_outcome: 0.067 Hz -> 2.95 Hz in the simulated cadence; pair green in battery #19.

attempts.predicted_outcome: benchmark run --verify-red stops printing FALSE-GREEN and feature_map_gate_ms returns PASS with red_ok true.
attempts.observed_outcome: NEG-ARM PASS rc 1; run --verify-red failures [] and subsystem.feature_map_gate_ms PASS 1344.18 ms.

root_cause: The GDI+ host died before any sample with 0xE0434352 (STATUS_CLR_EXCEPTION), so a spawn crash was scored as a product regression.

attempts.predicted_outcome: 1-of-4 caged failures become 0 without changing the measured 12.133 ms.

root_cause: 41 execFileSync/spawnSync call sites passed no timeout, so a hung child could outlive its budget and hang the caller.

attempts.action: Single index insertion of `timeout: 30000,` per call in 21 files plus two hoisted `-e` literals so the call fits the detector window; fail-fast pair wired into the battery.
attempts.rationale: Nothing may silently hang; the detector's own window is part of the contract, so the source was made detectable rather than the detector loosened.
attempts.predicted_outcome: fail_fast_audit scan --gate 41 -> 0 findings; node --check green on all 21; every previously-green selftest still green.
attempts.observed_outcome: 0 findings; 21/21 node --check; 15/15 shadowplay suites and parse-gate 9/9 PASS. Commits 509594d, 96c678e. The 3 dispatch-guard reds are pre-existing and need the uninstalled plugin.

root_cause: `loaded=bridge.loaded` read the bridge between the state publish and the load publish, so the ready-before-open arm failed 1 in 3 under cProfile.

attempts.action: Bounded 5 s barrier on bridge.loaded with a named failure `bridge never reported loaded after frontend-ready`; deadline still fails.
attempts.rationale: An arm that observes a producer between two ticks measures the scheduler, not the product.
attempts.predicted_outcome: The arm is green in repeated runs under cProfile, and the named failure fires when the barrier is not met.
attempts.observed_outcome: Arm green in repeated runs; the named failure fires when the barrier is not met.

attempts.action: Built _main/_slot-cosine-distribution.py over 120 s of the owner's multi-voice call and measured same-voice vs different-voice cosine distributions.
attempts.rationale: A name must never be wrong, so the threshold had to separate the populations before any code shipped.

unresolved: Slot identity during sparse speech stays unsolved; the dashboard may paint one colour too many for one person.
